# Subway Seat for Element

A custom theme that sets Element's Compound color scales from the palette, so every surface follows: a paneling timeline, espresso room list and blackout space bar, orange where Element uses its green accent (success stays avocado), and usernames in the warm accents. Element Desktop and self-hosted Element take all three from config.json; app.element.io adds one at a time from a theme URL. Element's “Match system theme” only switches between its own light and dark themes, so custom themes don't follow the OS.

[Element](https://element.io) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/element/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Element › Settings › Appearance (turn off “Match system theme” first):

```text
Theme: Subway Seat
// or, in config.json: "default_theme": "custom-Subway Seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Element › Settings › Appearance (turn off “Match system theme” first):

```text
Theme: Subway Seat Tunnel
// or, in config.json: "default_theme": "custom-Subway Seat Tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Element › Settings › Appearance (turn off “Match system theme” first):

```text
Theme: Subway Seat Enamel
// or, in config.json: "default_theme": "custom-Subway Seat Enamel"
```

**London Moquette**, in Element › Settings › Appearance (turn off “Match system theme” first):

```text
Theme: London Moquette
// or, in config.json: "default_theme": "custom-London Moquette"
```

**London Deep Level**, in Element › Settings › Appearance (turn off “Match system theme” first):

```text
Theme: London Deep Level
// or, in config.json: "default_theme": "custom-London Deep Level"
```

**London Portland**, in Element › Settings › Appearance (turn off “Match system theme” first):

```text
Theme: London Portland
// or, in config.json: "default_theme": "custom-London Portland"
```
